paragraphs: Georgia Hunter Bell has enjoyed a remarkable year, securing a hat-trick of gold medals at the World Indoor Championships, for England at the Commonwealth Games, and for Team GB at the European Championships. Yet British female track success in 2025 extended well beyond her individual feats. Sprinter Amy Hunt made headlines with a record four-gold display at the Europeans in Birmingham, while Dina Asher-Smith now tops the all-time medal table at the championships after claiming her 11th medal, eight of which are gold.

Among other notable achievements, Keely Hodgkinson clinched World Indoor gold in the 800m in March, recording the second-fastest indoor time in history, and set a new British record at that distance in the summer. However, she was pipped to gold at the Europeans after sitting out the Commonwealth Games due to muscle tightness. Hunter Bell, reflecting on this era of success, told Sky Sports: "It's really cool just being part of this era. It's really fun. We all know each other very well. We all travel together, see each other a lot throughout the year, so it's fun to tune in and be like, 'Oh, Amy's racing tonight'. We're locked into everyone's goals and what they're trying to do. And when you're on a team together, someone winning or bringing home a medal, it makes you even more keen to do well because you want to contribute."

Beyond her record-breaking performances on the track, Hunt garnered attention for her curated nail art that paid homage to Birmingham landmarks such as the Bull Ring. "Everyone knows I love a bit of glam and I love my nails," Hunt told the BBC at the time. Hunter Bell says this sense of glamour is shared across the GB squad, as feeling your best self on the start line can provide "that extra one or two per cent" to make you "feel like you can do anything". "I enjoy the whole process of getting ready. We get ready like we're going to a club, we're quite glammed up," Hunter Bell said. "We definitely put effort into it, for sure. We want to look nice. It's about doing whatever you need to feel confident on the start line – and I just think it makes you race better if you're feeling good about yourself. So much of that comes from the training and the lead up, of course. But it's that extra one or two per cent that makes you stand on the start line and feel like you can do anything, feel like you're a winner."

In terms of eye-catching track looks, Hodgkinson dominated the final race of her 2026 season by winning the 800m at Athlos in London last month, debuting a new full-length, hooded speed suit. Hodgkinson's outfit reminded people of Australian Cathy Freeman's suit, which she wore when winning the women's 400m at the 2000 Sydney Olympics, and it could become a feature for athletes at the next Olympics in Los Angeles in 2028. Hunter Bell didn't rule out being one of them to don the suit. "The first time you see it, it's like, 'Whoa! Haven't seen that before,'" she said. "It will be interesting to see whether it becomes the norm. They do say it's quicker, so I'm definitely not ruling it out."
paragraphs_zh: 乔治亚·亨特·贝尔度过了非凡的一年，在世界室内锦标赛、英联邦运动会（代表英格兰）和欧洲锦标赛（代表英国队）上连夺三金。然而，2025年英国女子田径的成功远不止她个人的成就。短跑运动员艾米·亨特在伯明翰欧锦赛上斩获创纪录的四枚金牌，登上头条；而迪娜·阿舍-史密斯在赢得第11枚奖牌（其中八枚金牌）后，现在高居该赛事历史奖牌榜首位。

在其他显著成就中，基利·霍奇金森在三月的世界室内锦标赛上夺得800米金牌，跑出历史第二快的室内成绩，并在夏天刷新了该距离的英国纪录。不过，她因肌肉紧张缺席英联邦运动会，后在欧锦赛上惜败摘银。亨特·贝尔在回顾这一成功时代时告诉天空体育：“能成为这个时代的一部分真的很酷。非常有趣。我们彼此非常了解。我们经常一起旅行，一年中经常见面，所以关注比赛很有趣，就像‘哦，艾米今晚比赛’。我们关注每个人的目标和努力方向。当你们在同一队时，有人获胜或带回奖牌，会让你更渴望做好，因为你想做出贡献。”

除了在跑道上破纪录的表现，亨特还因精心设计的指甲艺术而备受关注，这些指甲艺术致敬了伯明翰的地标，如斗牛场购物中心。亨特当时告诉BBC：“每个人都知道我喜欢一点华丽，我喜欢我的指甲。”亨特·贝尔表示，这种华丽感是英国队共有的，因为在起跑线上感觉最佳能提供“那额外的一两个百分点”，让你“觉得自己无所不能”。“我享受准备的全过程。我们像去夜店一样准备，打扮得相当华丽，”亨特·贝尔说。“我们确实下了功夫，当然。我们想看起来漂亮。关键在于做任何你需要的事，让自己在起跑线上充满信心——我觉得如果你对自己感觉良好，比赛也会更好。当然，很多来自训练和准备。但正是那额外的一两个百分点，让你站在起跑线上时觉得自己无所不能，觉得自己是赢家。”

在引人注目的赛道造型方面，霍奇金森上个月在伦敦Athlos比赛中赢得800米，统治了她2026赛季的最后一场比赛，首次展示了新的全长连帽速度套装。霍奇金森的服装让人想起澳大利亚选手凯茜·弗里曼在2000年悉尼奥运会上赢得女子400米时所穿的套装，这可能成为2028年洛杉矶下届奥运会上运动员的特色。亨特·贝尔没有排除自己成为穿该套装的人之一。“第一次看到它时，你会觉得，‘哇！以前没见过，’”她说。“看看它是否会成为常态会很有趣。他们确实说它更快，所以我绝对不排除这个可能。”
